annotations.exact_quote: Semi-supervised learning by mixed label propagation
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确将研究任务定为半监督学习，摘要也以半监督图方法为背景处理未标注样本的类别分配。

annotations.exact_quote: Recent studies have shown that graph-based approaches are effective for semi-supervised learning.
annotations.reason_zh: 半监督学习使用有限监督和未标注样本，属于不完整监督的弱监督条件，且论文将其作为实质研究设定。

annotations.exact_quote: In this paper, we propose a new graph-based approach, termed as “mixed label propagation ” which is able to effectively explore both similarity and dissimilarity simultaneously.
annotations.reason_zh: 提出混合标签传播，同时利用相似与不相似关系，符合对 must-link/cannot-link 类成对关系进行传播的机制。

annotations.exact_quote: In particular, the new framework determines the assignment of class labels by (1) minimizing the energy function associated with positive similarity, and (2) maximizing the energy function associated with negative similarity.
annotations.reason_zh: 新框架通过正/负相似性能量函数约束类别分配，属于在图结构上施加几何一致性约束的图正则化机制。
